TERMS OF USE
DEFINITIONS
“We”, “FB Network”, “Face Wash Fox”: FB NETWORK JOINT STOCK COMPANY.
“Customer”, “You”: An individual aged 15 or over, or an organization using Face Wash Fox services.
“Services”: All beauty services, skincare services, treatment packages and other amenities provided by Face Wash Fox.

“Foxie Membership Card”/“Foxie Card”: A membership card issued by Face Wash Fox in the form of an electronic account, comprising various membership packages with different benefits and policies (these policies may change depending on the programs introduced by Face Wash Fox's sales and operations departments from time to time). The card purchase amount is converted directly into “Foxie Point” (accumulated points) for payment for Face Wash Fox services. This is not a form of advance top-up, is not refundable or cancellable, and does not constitute a debt repayable by Face Wash Fox.

“Foxie Point”: Accumulated points converted from the purchase value of a Foxie Membership Card, allowing customers to pay for beauty services, skincare services and treatments throughout the Face Wash Fox network. Foxie Point cannot be exchanged for cash and expires in accordance with the rules of each package.

“Voucher”: A physical discount coupon or electronic offer issued by Face Wash Fox, applicable to specific services, with its own validity period and conditions of use, and non-refundable and non-transferable unless otherwise specified.
“Member”: A customer who has purchased and activated a Foxie Membership Card.

CONDITIONS OF USE

To ensure legal compliance and reduce the risk of disputes, the following specific conditions govern users' use of Services, Foxie Membership Cards and Vouchers. Users must comply with these conditions when using them, and Face Wash Fox may refuse service if a violation is detected.
Conditions for using Services:

Registration requirements: Users must register an account with accurate information (full name, telephone number, email) and agree to the data privacy policy. User accounts are only available to individuals aged 15 or over; those under 18 require their guardian's consent.

Lawful use: Users undertake to use the services for personal purposes and not to misuse them for unlawful business, false advertising or infringement of intellectual property rights (for example, sharing service images without permission).

Restrictions: Services may be interrupted due to system maintenance or technical problems; Face Wash Fox will provide at least 24 hours' notice where possible. Users may not copy or distribute service content without written consent.

User responsibilities: Users are responsible for all transactions arising from their accounts, including keeping their passwords secure. If misuse is detected, Face Wash Fox may temporarily lock the account and require verification.

Expiry and termination: Services may expire according to the subscription package or be extended at the final discretion of the Operations Department; users may cancel at any time but will not receive a refund for the portion already used.
Conditions for using the Foxie Membership Card:

Purchase and activation procedure: Cards are purchased through the Application or at Face Wash Fox stores, with their value immediately converted into Foxie Point (the conversion rate is clearly announced at the time of purchase, for example: 1.000.000 VND = 1.000.000 Foxie Point). The card is activated immediately after the customer completes payment as required, applies only to a personal account and is non-transferable.

Using Foxie Point: Foxie Point may only be used to pay for services within the Face Wash Fox network (not applicable to third-party products). Foxie Point is deducted automatically when the customer finishes using the service; if the balance is insufficient, the user must pay the remainder using accepted payment methods. Foxie Point cannot be accumulated from other sources except official promotional programs.

Expiry and invalidation: Foxie Point expires after 12 months (depending on the specific case, Foxie Point may be further extended at the discretion of the Operations Department); unused Foxie Point expires automatically without a refund. If an account is locked due to a violation, Foxie Point will be cancelled without compensation.

Restrictions and prohibitions: The Foxie Membership Card must not be used for fraud or combined with other offers unless permitted by the applicable rules. Face Wash Fox may adjust the Foxie Point conversion rate with 07 (seven) days' prior notice.
User responsibilities: Users must check their Foxie Point balance periodically through the application; complaints/disputes concerning Foxie Point must be submitted within 30 days of the transaction.
Conditions for using Vouchers:

Receipt and redemption procedure: Vouchers are issued through the application, email or physical coupons, with a unique code. To redeem a voucher, users must book the service in advance through the application, hotline, Facebook fanpage, … and present the voucher information when visiting the store to use the service; vouchers apply only to specific services (for example: a 20% discount on a skincare treatment).

Conditions of application: Vouchers cannot be combined with other offers, do not apply to already discounted services and may only be used once. Face Wash Fox is not responsible for replacing lost physical vouchers.

Expiry and invalidation: Vouchers expire on the date stated on the coupon (within 30 - 180 days); after expiry, vouchers automatically become invalid without a refund. If misuse is detected (for example: use of a counterfeit voucher), Face Wash Fox may cancel the voucher and lock the account.

Restrictions and prohibitions: Vouchers are non-transferable, cannot be exchanged for cash, and apply only at the designated Face Wash Fox locations. Users may not copy or distribute vouchers without permission.
User responsibilities: Users must check voucher conditions before use; disputes must be raised as complaints within 07 (seven) days of redemption.
